title: Automation Systems
hook: Four hours copying invoices last week. A tool does it in seconds.
statement: If it needs no decision, it shouldn't need you.
explainer: Every repeat task you still touch makes you the bottleneck.
sop: List every no-brainer task you repeat.
Automate the most frequent one first.
equation_example: Automated 6 ÷ Total Tasks 10 = 60%. The rest is still your grunt work.
question: Write down one task a tool should own.
closing_statement: Every manual task is a leash.
